scenes.text: The *$5-a-video* creator trick that grew Turbo AI

scenes.title: What *it is*
lines: Turbo AI's founders paid friends and small creators $5 per TikTok, plus a bonus if one went viral.
Zach Yadegari used the same play for Cal AI. Lots of small videos beat one big ad.

scenes.title: Step 1: *the brief*, with ChatGPT
lines: Prompt: 'Write a one-page creator brief for my app: 3 hooks, must-say features, 15-second format, hashtags.'
Keep it to one page. Creators skim.

scenes.title: Step 2: *find 20 creators*
lines: Search your niche on TikTok. Filter 1,000 to 20,000 followers. DM twenty.
Offer $5 per video plus $50 if it clears 100,000 views. Pay the same day.

scenes.title: Step 3: *track it*
lines: Claude prompt: 'Build me a Google Sheet tracker: creator, link, views at 24 hours and 7 days, paid.'
Double down on the two creators whose videos actually move signups.

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: 20 creators times 3 videos is 60 videos for $300. One viral hit plus its bonus is still under $400.
Turbo AI got its first 1,000 users with cookies and this. Source: Business Insider, June 29, 2026.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Most videos will flop. The method works on volume, not luck.
Disclose paid posts; TikTok requires the branded-content label.
